title: Is it possible to identify ancient wine production using biomolecular approaches?
version: STAR: Science & Technology of Archaeological Research 6(1), pp. 16–29.
lineage: Independent methodological assessment and original analyses of separate Zamostje 2 samples.

passages.note: Tartaric acid can occur in vessels beyond the plausible range of ancient wine contact. For grape juice or wine interpretation the archaeological context and comparative chemistry matter.
